description: Human-labelled transcripts for calibrating Layer 2 judging. Each item carries the criteria a reviewer approved, the agent's final text, and the verdict two reviewers agreed on. The offline fake judge must reach the labelled verdict on every item; a real provider is measured against the same file with `suncly judge calibrate` (reported, never asserted).
